abstract_research_topics.justification: Misclassification detection involves developing algorithms to identify and reduce classification errors, which is a theoretical aspect of improving the robustness and accuracy of deep learning models.

Ontology alignment deals with aligning structures within ontologies, often requiring conceptual models and theories in AI and machine learning to ensure consistent and correct information retrieval and knowledge representation.
AI alignment involves abstract and theoretical research to ensure AI systems' goals are aligned with human intents, making it a theoretical domain.
Multimodal alignment involves integrating and aligning data from multiple modalities (e.g., images, text), which is a complex, abstract computational challenge in deep learning.
Protein representation learning focuses on theoretical models that can represent complex biological data for subsequent tasks, aligning it with abstract research.

Protein language models are a research topic involving developing models to understand protein sequences' structure and function, requiring theoretical advancements in language modeling adapted to biological data.

application_domains.justification: Misinformation detection involves applying deep learning techniques to real-world data to identify and mitigate false information, a practical and application-oriented domain.
Phylogenetics applies deep learning to the study of evolutionary relationships among organisms, a practical application of computational biology.
Protein structural design uses deep learning to simulate and predict new protein structures, which is a practical application in biotechnology and drug discovery.
Structural biology involves the study of biological macromolecules' structure and is directly applied alongside computational techniques like deep learning to solve real biological questions.
Protein function prediction involves predicting functions based on structure, sequence, or interaction networks, applying deep learning to solve practical biological questions.
Protein structure prediction deals with predicting 3D organization of proteins from their sequences, a practical and essential application in drug design and functional annotation.
Similar to 'protein function pred.', involves practical applications to predict the biological roles of proteins.
Similar to 'protein structure pred.', involves applied methodologies to predict the physical structure of proteins from sequence data.
Protein modeling entails using computational methods to simulate the molecular structure and dynamics of proteins, a realistic application in the field of structural biology.
Single-cell data science applies advanced computational techniques, including deep learning, to analyze the vast data generated by single-cell studies, which is an application domain.
Single-cell RNA-seq uses sequencing technology to explore gene expression at a single-cell level, applying deep learning to process and interpret these data in real-world studies.
Single-cell genomics applies deep learning in genomics at single-cell resolution for more refined data interpretation, a crucial real-world application.
Single-cell transcriptomics employs deep learning to analyze transcription data from single cells, a real-world, practical application in genomics.
Cancer transcriptomics uses deep learning to analyze gene expression changes in cancer, applying techniques to solve real clinical problems.
Type 2 diabetes transcriptomics applies to using transcriptomics data and deep learning algorithms to understand this disease better and develop diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.
Clinical proteomics involves using deep learning for the analysis of protein expressions in clinical samples to improve diagnostics and treatment decisions in healthcare.
Proteogenomics integrates proteomic and genomic information using deep learning, applying these techniques in biomedical research and clinical diagnostics.
Genomics employs deep learning to analyze and interpret genetic data to understand genetic susceptibility, disease, and biological functions in a practical application.
This domain combines genomics and metabolomics with deep learning to analyze complex biological systems and their functions, applying these to real-world challenges in biology and medicine.
